name: branding-ai-head-silhouette-logo-with-gradient-circuit-lines
title: AI brand mark: a black head silhouette filled with a pink-to-yellow gradient circuit maze
whatItIs: A minimalist logo of a black human head in profile, with a winding circuit-board-style line in a pink-orange-yellow gradient running through the brain area, dotted with small circles like nodes, on a white background.
whatItMeans: Smart and approachable; a warm gradient circuit inside a human silhouette humanises artificial intelligence rather than making it feel cold.
techniques: Fill a silhouette's interior with a symbolic pattern instead of a solid colour.
Use a warm gradient to soften a technical circuit motif.
Dot the circuit line with small nodes for a data feel.

vocabulary.definition: Using the inside of an outline shape to hold a secondary pattern.
A winding line pattern resembling electronic pathways.
